answers.core: This might be feasible using a GDNative-based add-on. However, since high refresh rate displays will probably be the norm in a few years' time, it's probably better to support this as a core feature.
answers.workaround: It *might* be possible to do this on Linux by calling `xrandr`, but it's not particularly user-friendly. On other platforms (especially mobile platforms), this may not be possible at all.

title: Add an OS method to retrieve a screen's refresh rate
